# loopyng

> Generate synthetic signals for ML pipelines


## Pages in this subsection

- [loopyng](loopyng.html.md): Tools to create audio
- [loopyng.gen](loopyng.gen.html.md): Generate Audio
- [loopyng.gen.diagnosis_sounds](loopyng.gen.diagnosis_sounds.html.md): Tools for generating diagnostic audio signals.
- [loopyng.gen.signal_generators](loopyng.gen.signal_generators.html.md): Generating Signals
- [loopyng.gen.simple](loopyng.gen.simple.html.md): Waveforms generated only with builtins (no numpy etc.)
- [loopyng.gen.sine_mix](loopyng.gen.sine_mix.html.md): Utilities for creating and mixing sine wave signals.
- [loopyng.gen.util](loopyng.gen.util.html.md): util, constants, defaults
- [loopyng.gen.voiced_time](loopyng.gen.voiced_time.html.md): Voice-based time announcement utilities.
- [loopyng.lite_sample_sounds](loopyng.lite_sample_sounds.html.md): Generate simple waveforms for audio synthesis and testing.
- [loopyng.sound](loopyng.sound.html.md): Sound utils
- [loopyng.sound.audio](loopyng.sound.audio.html.md): Audio processing and playback utilities.
- [loopyng.sound.audio_librosa](loopyng.sound.audio_librosa.html.md): Utils to view, hear, and manipulate audio.
- [loopyng.util](loopyng.util.html.md): A few general utils
- [loopyng.utils](loopyng.utils.html.md): General utils
- [loopyng.utils.date_ticks](loopyng.utils.date_ticks.html.md): Date tick formatting utilities for time-based plots.
- [loopyng.utils.infinite_waveform](loopyng.utils.infinite_waveform.html.md): Infinite waveform generation tools.
- [loopyng.utils.librosa_utils](loopyng.utils.librosa_utils.html.md): A few utils (specshow, melspectrogram) vendored from librosa.
- [loopyng.utils.plotting](loopyng.utils.plotting.html.md): Plot utilities for visualizing audio waveforms and spectrograms.
